{{Quote|My name's Nokril. I work for the Empire, securing valuable resources by whatever means necessary. I'm here because the Empire discovered how to process spice into painkillers. Save sick and injured soldiers when there's not enough kolto around.|Nokril|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Nokril''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] employed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] to acquire resources. At some point during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] he was on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to buy a shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro]], as the Empire had discovered new medical properties of spice.<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nokril is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Nolan North]].<ref name="TOR" />
